## Routing Decision — Chapter 5B (Economic Wellbeing)

| chunk_id | decision | applicable_5B_lenses | adjacent_context_identified | exclusion_reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **U0011** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Biographical/political-party background; organizational career moves, university degree, formation of Corriente Democrática; no concrete policy action, measured outcome, cost, or distributional finding for any 5B lens. |
| **U0012** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Electoral history of 1988 federal election and López Obrador's gubernatorial candidacy; fraud allegations and denunciations; political coalition naming; no enacted budget, fiscal rule, regulatory action, tax measure, or investment decision. |
| **U0013** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | PRD founding (May 1989), local-march protest tactics, mobilization strategy; civic-protest narrative; no economic policy enactment, budget execution, or distributional result. |
| **U0014** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Second Tabasco gubernatorial campaign (1994), fraud allegations, document filing with PGR, mobilization protests; opposition to oil-sector segmentation stated as ideological position; no enacted fiscal rule, regulatory reform, or measurable economic outcome. |
| **U0015** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | PRD internal-party leadership election (July 1996), vote counts, faction dynamics, party dissatisfaction with electoral results; internal party governance; no policy enactment or economic governance act. |
| **U0016** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | PRD electoral victories 1997–1999 at DF, state, and federal levels; party presidency handoff; no enacted economic policy, budget execution, or regulatory measure. |
| **U0017** | **INCLUDE** | 5B.3, 5B.5, 5B.10 | González Pedrero destituición (U0011), FDN coalition (U0012), PRD founding (U0013) provide period context | FOBAPROA characterization as "fraude más grande" — López Obrador's own published finding that the Salinas-era banking rescue instrument was unconstitutional; this constitutes a concrete attribution fact bearing on fiscal-rule credibility (5B.3), anti-corruption enforcement willingness (5B.5), and inherited institutional quality (5B.10). Cites specific instrument name, administrative origin, and legal-constitutional qualification. |
| **U0018** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | 2000 federal election results; López Obrador's DF head-of-government margin and vote percentage; coalition composition; electoral-context narrative; no economic policy enactment. |
| **U0019** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Character and governance-style description for 2000–2005 period; mentions commitment to "rendición de cuentas, transparencia y democracia participativa" as claimed orientation; no concrete policy action, enacted budget, regulatory reform, or measured outcome. Generic governance philosophy, not evidence of implementation. |
| **U0020** | **EXCLUDE** | — | — | Personal communication style ("mañaneras"), media-use tactics, nickname origin; contrast with adversaries' rhetorical profiles; no policy action, outcome, cost, or distributional result. |

---

### Summary

- **Total chunks evaluated:** 10 (U0011–U0020)
- **Included:** 1 — **U0017** (FOBAPROA / fiscal-rule credibility; anti-corruption posture; institutional inheritance)
- **Excluded:** 9 — all assessed as biographical, electoral/political-cycle narrative, internal-party mechanics, or governance-style description lacking any concrete policy action, measured outcome, cost figure, distributional result, or implementation finding.

**Routing rationale for included chunk:** U0017 survived because it names a specific government financial instrument (FOBAPROA), attributes it to a named administration (Salinas), and advances a concrete legal-constitutional characterization (unconstitutionality) and a magnitude claim ("fraude más grande") — qualifying as an attribution fact and a contrary finding bearing on fiscal-rule credibility (5B.3), anti-corruption enforcement willingness (5B.5), and the durability of the inherited institutional trajectory (5B.10). The surrounding chunks (U0011–U0016, U0018) are necessary contextual scaffolding but do not independently meet the evidence threshold.
